summary: Phone GPS feeds Google Maps camera/car marker; detector GPS via BLE ETC feeds the tach gauge. Live coordinates are not written to the radar. NMEA mock simulation is shipped off.

anchors.note: Live GPS: LocationManager.requestLocationUpdates("gps", 800ms, 5m). Broadcasts GPSStatusUpdate.GPS_LOCATION_UPDATE with Constant.GPS_LOCATION_EXTRA. FusedLocationProviderClient is a 3s stationary one-shot fallback (priority 100).

SupportMapFragment + GoogleMap. MOCKLOCATION_ON is compile-time false. Camera follows GPS with speed-based zoom and geodesic Destination offset; custom car marker. FusedLocation getLastLocation/getCurrentLocation seeds first fix. MyLocationListener is constructed and never registered.

NMEA replay from Documents/UNIDEN/gps1.txt (R.raw.gps1). MOCKLOCATION_ON true → setTestProviderLocation; else mockSimulatedLocation. No startService caller in BaseApplication.onCreate. MockLocationProvider data.txt path is dead (mockLocationProviderSingletonStarted defaults true).
Tach/speedometer is detector GPS speed from BLE ETC field index 2 (gpsDirection,currentSpeed,altitude,gpsStatus), not phone Location.getSpeed().
Hex POI packets on SETTINGS_CHARACTERISTIC_UUID_3. Prefix 01/02/03. BLE writes BTreqUMRK:1 (add, detector GPS), BTreqUMRK:0,{hexLat},{hexLng} (delete from map), BTreqRLCD:0.
No ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION. queries com.google.android.apps.maps. No Map Activity; map is MapsFragment. LocationDriverService exported=false.
Phone GPS is not sent to the detector. Detector reports its own gpsStatus/currentSpeed on ETC_DATA_CHARACTERISTIC_UUID. Quiet Ride is mute type 6, not GeofencingClient.
